title: Swedish Translation & Cross-Linguistic Terminology Knowledge Graph – TOTAL Översättningsbyrå
description: Swedish Translation & Cross-Linguistic Terminology Knowledge Graph is a structured, machine-readable linguistic dataset covering over 170 languages, language pairs, and 2,300+ specialized articles on professional translation, certified translation (Kammarkollegiet), localization, and terminology management, curated by TOTAL översättningsbyrå (oversattning.se).
